title: Pass 15b - Hero index scroll slowed ~1.3x native with JS animation
summary: Replaced CSS scroll-behavior anchor jumps with rAF animation (easeInOutCubic) whose duration = 1.3 x Chrome's native estimate (220ms + 0.15ms/px, clamped 360-1400). Targets via offsetTop chain so card reveal transforms don't deflect aim; per-frame retarget absorbs late layout shifts; 2.4s settle chase; wheel/touchstart cancels; prefers-reduced-motion falls back to instant scrollIntoView. Verified headless: short hop ~516ms vs ~290ms native, long ~539ms, mobile tap lands at card, wheel cancels clean.
